r.name: Pennine Bridleway Interim Route for Walkers
Mam Tor Circular Walk, High Peak
r.description: Views of the Peak District. Plan ahead, can get extremely busy on weekends. Moderate walking on good paths, some steps and steep climbs. Several gates and stiles. Steep paths may be slippery when wet.

r.name: Mam Tor Cavedale Loop, High Peak
Below Kinder Scout: A Circular Walk Around Kinder Reservoir, High Peak
r.description: Circular route on Snake Path from Hayfield. Views of reservoir and High Peak. Dogs must be kept on leads.

r.name: Edale Circular Walk, High Peak
r.description: Low level circular walk which includes part of the Pennine Way, following streams and stone-flagged paths. Dogs must be kept on leads.

r.name: Kinder Scout Circular Walk, High Peak
r.description: Moorland walk, to stay safe, make sure someone knows when you are expected to finish. Paths good but rugged. Some challenging ascents and descents. Good fitness level and walking equipment required. Dogs should be on leads.

r.name: Kinder Scout Mass Trespass Walk, High Peak
r.description: Paths good but can be rough in places, moderately challenging ascents and descents. Take care when walking near the gritstone edges. Dogs should be on leads at all times.
